description_en: This topic describes the syntax and provides examples of the GenerateVideo operation for general video generation
description_zh: 本文介绍通用视频生成GenerateVideo的语法及示例
kebab_example: aliyun videoenhan generate-video --file-list FileUrl=http://viapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/viapi-3.0domepic/videoenhan/GenerateVideo/1-video1.mp4 Type=video FileName=1-video1.mp4 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GenerateVideo

parameters.help_en:
The scene type for video generation. Valid values:

costume: costume scene (default)
general: general scene
keeporder: forces video scene composition in the order of input materials
parameters.help_zh:
生成视频场景类型。取值如下：

costume：服饰场景（默认）
general：通用场景
keeporder：强制按输入素材顺序合成视频场景
parameters.name: scene

parameters.help_en: The width of the output video. Valid values: 32 to 2160
parameters.name: width

parameters.help_en: The height of the output video. Valid values: 32 to 2160. If neither width nor height is specified, the output resolution is 750 × 750. If only one is specified, the output aspect ratio is 1:1
parameters.help_zh: 输出视频的height，取值范围32~2160。若width和height均没有设置，则按照750×750输出。如果设置了其中一个，则按照1:1输出
parameters.name: height

parameters.help_en: The pace of the output video. Valid values: normal, fast, and slow. Default value: normal
parameters.help_zh: 输出视频节奏。可选normal、fast、slow。默认为normal
parameters.name: style

parameters.help_en:
The duration of the output video. Unit: seconds. Default value: 20.
The minimum output video duration is 5 seconds, and the maximum is 60 seconds
parameters.help_zh:
输出视频时长，单位为秒。默认为20秒。
视频输出最短为5秒，最长为60秒
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable adaptive output video duration. Valid values: true and false. If this parameter is set to true, the Duration parameter does not take effect
parameters.help_zh: 输出视频时长自适应。取值true或false，为true时`Duration`设置不生效
parameters.name: duration_adaption

parameters.help_en:
The shot transition style. A total of 15 styles are available. If this parameter is not specified, a random style is selected based on Style.
The following shot transition styles are supported: basic (none), slow (soothing), fast (dynamic), normal (natural), ink (ink wash), glitch (mechanical glitch), shift (switch), mosaic (mosaic), shutter (venetian blind), zoom (zoom), mask (mask), brush (brush), wind (wind dance), and smog (smoke)
parameters.help_zh:
镜头转场风格。共计15种风格。如果没有设置则按照`Style`随机。
目前支持的镜头转场风格包括：basic（无）、slow（舒缓）、fast（动感）、normal（自然）、ink（水墨）、glitch（机械故障）、shift（切换）、mosaic（马赛克）、shutter（百叶窗）、zoom（缩放）、mask（遮罩）、brush（笔刷）、wind（风舞）、smog（烟雾）
parameters.name: transition_style

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to add intelligent effects. Default value: true. Audio-visual synchronization and static-to-dynamic effects are currently supported
parameters.help_zh: 是否添加智能特效，默认为true。当前支持音画联动和静转动特效
parameters.name: smart_effect

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable dynamic collage effects, which display multiple video and image materials through collage in a single shot. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否动态拼图特效，支持在单镜头中通过拼图展示多个视频图像素材。默认为false
parameters.name: puzzle_effect

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to mute the generated video. Default value: false.

If no audio material is provided or the video material has no sound, the generated video has no music
parameters.help_zh:
生成视频是否静音。默认为false。

如果没有音乐素材或视频素材无声时生成的视频没有音乐
parameters.name: mute

fields.help_en: The name of the input file. For video and audio files in MP4 or MP3 format, the file extension can be omitted. For other formats, the file extension is required
fields.help_zh: 输入文件名称。视频音频文件格式为MP4或MP3时，可以忽略文件后缀。其他格式必须包含后缀
fields.name: file_name

fields.help_en:
The URL of the input file. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the China (Shanghai) region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.
Input limits:
Image format: JPG or PNG.
Image size: Each image must be greater than 30 KB and less than 100 MB.
Audio format: MP3.
Video format: MP4, AVI, MKV, or MOV.
Video size: Up to 1 GB.
A maximum of 5 video materials are supported, and the total duration cannot exceed 3 minutes. Excess content is automatically truncated and discarded (the first 3 minutes are retained in the order of input videos). A maximum of 40 image materials and 1 audio material are supported.
The URL cannot contain Chinese characters
fields.help_zh:
输入文件URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。
输入限制：
图片格式：JPG、PNG。
图片大小：每张图片大于30 KB，小于100 MB。
音频格式：MP3。
视频格式：MP4、AVI、MKV、MOV。
视频大小：不超过1 GB。
视频素材最多5个，且总时长不超过3分钟，超过部分会被自动截断丢弃（按输入视频顺序保留前3分钟）。图像素材最多40个。音频素材最多1个。
URL地址中不能包含中文字符
fields.name: file_url

fields.help_en:
The type of the input file. Valid values: video, audio, and image.
You can input multiple types of materials at the same time (video+image+audio, video+image, video+audio, or image+audio)
fields.help_zh:
输入文件类型。包括video、audio、image。
可以同时输入多种素材（video+image+audio或video+image或video+audio或image+audio）
fields.name: type

Data.description_en:
The returned data.
After the asynchronous task is executed successfully, invoke the [GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html） operation and perform JSON deserialization on the Result field to obtain this data
Data.description_zh:
返回的结果数据内容。
该数据需要在异步任务执行成功后，通过调用[GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html）接口，对其Result字段进行JSON反序列化之后得到

VideoCoverUrl.description_en:
The URL of the output video cover image.
This URL is a temporary URL that is valid for 30 minutes. After it expires, the URL is no longer accessible. To store the file for a longer period or permanently, access the URL within 30 minutes and download the file to your own OSS bucket or other storage
VideoCoverUrl.description_zh:
输出视频封面URL地址。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间

VideoUrl.description_en:
The URL of the output video.
This URL is a temporary URL that is valid for 30 minutes. After it expires, the URL is no longer accessible. To store the file for a longer period or permanently, access the URL within 30 minutes and download the file to your own OSS bucket or other storage
VideoUrl.description_zh:
输出视频URL地址。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间

Message.description_en: The message returned after the asynchronous task is submitted
Message.description_zh: 提交异步任务后的提示信息
Message.example: 该调用为异步调用，任务已提交成功，请以requestId的值作为jobId参数调用同类目下GetAsyncJobResult接口查询任务执行状态和结果。
